title: Q2 2024 Financial Performance Report
content: Executive Financial Summary for Q2 2024: Consolidated revenue accelerated to $4,800,000, driven by rapid adoption of intelligent workflow solutions. Operating expenses totaled $3,552,000, with R&D allocation increasing to $920,000. Operating margin improved to 26.0%, delivering net profit of $1,248,000. Capital expenditure (CapEx) for server infrastructure was $310,000.
